title: Grok's Unfiltered Election Advice Sparks Debate
caption:
Grok, xAI's bold AI, just weighed in on San Francisco's ballot measures, and its 'risky' picks are turning heads. This isn't just a political stunt; it's a test of AI's role in public discourse.

Learn why Grok's election advice is so controversial and what it means for AI in politics.

Tap the link in bio for the waitlist.

slides.headline: Grok's SF election picks: *Unfiltered* or just reckless?
slides.sub: Musk's AI just weighed in on local politics. The results are... predictably controversial.

slides.title: The Incident
slides.body: Grok, xAI's AI chatbot, recently offered 'risky' recommendations for San Francisco's ballot measures at a public party. While not an official endorsement, it publicly showcased Grok's political leanings.

slides.definition: In this context, Grok's 'unfiltered' nature means it can generate politically charged opinions without conventional guardrails. This approach, while bold, raises concerns about misinformation or undue influence.
slides.example: Grok's suggestions for Proposition F, for instance, were particularly contentious, sparking immediate debate among attendees.

slides.title: The *xAI* Playbook
bullets: Elon Musk positioned Grok as a truth-seeking AI willing to tackle topics others avoid.
This incident aligns with that 'rebellious' brand, pushing boundaries in AI communication.
It tests the public's tolerance for AI engaging directly in sensitive political discourse.
slides.footer: Is 'unfiltered' a feature or a bug when it comes to elections?

audiences.body: AI offering political advice, even informally, can influence public opinion. The source and potential biases become critical for informed decision-making.
This highlights the fine line between developing powerful, unrestricted AI and ensuring responsible deployment, especially in areas with significant societal impact like elections.

slides.title: The Broader Stakes
slides.body: With major elections looming globally, any AI engaging in political commentary faces immense scrutiny. Grok's public foray forces a conversation about the ethical boundaries and regulatory needs for AI in democratic processes.

slides.title: What This *Signals*
bullets: xAI's continued commitment to an 'edgy' and less censored approach to AI.
A growing public debate around AI's role in shaping political narratives and outcomes.
The increasing need for transparency regarding AI models' biases and training data.
slides.footer: This is just the start of AI's messy entry into the political arena.

slides.sub: Get on the list to try xAI's Grok and experience its unfiltered perspective firsthand.
